reason: General review of retinal architecture; no GRM6 focus (GRM6 is only a mGluR6 bipolar-cell mention at most). Not GRM6-specific.
1983 review of retinal lipid chemistry/metabolism; predates ELOVL4 and PRCD discovery; no gene-specific content.
Human fetal rod differentiation study; plausibly examines NRL-driven rod program, but abstract is missing and no gene-specific focus is evident for AIPL1/TULP1.
Core SHH signaling paper (Sonic hedgehog as ZPA polarizing signal); it is SHH biology, though limb rather than eye.
POAG linkage mapping of the GLC1B locus, which is distinct from MYOC (GLC1A) and CYP1B1 (GLC3A). Glaucoma-genetics neighbour, not about either gene.
Review of cGMP/Ca2+ phototransduction messengers; discusses the rod cGMP-gated channel (CNGA1 biology) but is not gene-specific. HK1 has no link.
FOXC2 (MFH-1) mutations in lymphedema-distichiasis; paralog of FOXC1, not FOXC1 itself. Eyelid distichiasis is only a peripheral link.
1980s anatomical study of crossed/uncrossed retinofugal projections in albino vs pigmented mice; predates TENM3 and is not about TENM3 biology.
Angiopoietin-1 (the canonical TIE2 ligand) restores retinal vessel hierarchy; directly within TIE2/TEK signaling biology in the retina.
Zebrafish chokh/rx3 mutation causing eye loss; rx3 is the zebrafish ortholog of RAX, which is the gene under which the paper is filed.
